citations.purpose: Independently derive legal-parent spelling from the complete issuer-name line immediately preceding each recognized consolidated statement title.
citations.rule: Each page must have the expected title and a complete issuer-name line immediately before it; normalize only case and whitespace; all four names must be identical. The expected name is TransDigm Group Incorporated.

citations.purpose: Parent identity and consolidated group meaning in the filing's own definitions.
citations.source_text: In this report, the term ‘TD Group’ refers to TransDigm Group Incorporated, which holds all of the outstanding capital stock of TransDigm Inc. The terms ‘Company,’ ‘TransDigm,’ ‘we,’ ‘us,’ ‘our’ and similar terms, unless the context otherwise requires, refer to TD Group, together with TransDigm Inc. and its wholly-owned and majority-owned subsidiaries for which it has a controlling interest.

‘TD Group’, ‘TransDigm’, ‘we,’ ‘our’ or ‘us’ refer to TransDigm Group Incorporated and its subsidiaries. ... include the accounts of TD Group and subsidiaries. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated.
citations.rule: The accepted retained entity citation must be authenticated against the pinned source and its actual quote must contain the complete source-derived parent name. A locator alone, or a genuine but irrelevant quote that does not contain that name, is insufficient.

normalization.matching: Full-string match against exactly one of the two complete ordered templates after allowed normalization. Substitute only the authenticated source-derived parent name.
